item.title: Strengthened D‐p Orbital Hybridization Via Interlayer Coupling Enables Sulfur Redox Kinetics in Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
item.description:
با وارد کردن CTA+ به δ-MnO2، هیبریداسیون اوربیتالی Mn 3d-O 2p تقویت و شکاف انرژی d-p کاهش می‌یابد و سینتیک ردوکس گوگرد در باتری Li-S بهبود می‌یابد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Intercalating CTA⁺ into δ-MnO₂ narrows the Mn 3d–O 2p band center difference (1.458→1.145 eV), strengthening d–p hybridization and aligning Mn d-band with polysulfide S 2p orbitals. This optimizes adsorption and conversion kinetics while expanding ordered Li⁺ channels. The result: 819 mAh g⁻¹ at 3.0 C, 0.05% decay per cycle over 850 cycles, and 305 Wh kg⁻¹ in pouch cells.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · MnO2 interlayer coupling · d-p orbital hybridization · polysulfide catalysis · CTA intercalation

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using d-p orbital hybridization via substituent engineering on UiO-66 MOFs to tune electronic structure, creating an electronic-physical dual-shield interlayer. This deepens d-p coupling, enhances Zn²⁺ affinity, and excludes SO₄²⁻/H₂O. Significance: UiO-66-F₄ achieves 3600 h lifespan and 90% depth of discharge, establishing orbital hybridization as a paradigm for ultra-stable Zn anodes.

💡 This review uniquely systematizes asymmetric coordination chemistry and dual-atom structures in single-atom catalysts for Li-S batteries, linking geometric configuration, orbital hybridization, and interfacial charge rearrangement to polysulfide conversion kinetics. It establishes screening and design principles for coordination structures, bridging theoretical calculations with experimental validation—a previously unexplored structure-activity framework—offering significant guidance for advancing catalytic efficiency and Li-S battery performance.
